content.rationale: Students on academic probation must obtain DGS approval for all extensions.

steps.content:
Your extension request has been reviewed and requires approval from the Graduate School (DGS) office. Students on academic probation (your current standing) must obtain DGS review and authorization for all extensions. You've already used 2 extensions this term, and the policy (POLICY-EXT-001) mandates additional oversight for probationary students.

Please contact the DGS office directly to submit your request for review. They will assess your circumstances and determine if further action is needed. Let me know if you'd like help finding their contact information or need assistance with other graduate-related matters!
